=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: The 6469 changelog fragment's "What this means for operators" paragraph still describes the removed "guide-and-paste" fallback behavior, but the LAST RUN DIFF tightened both the live and template deploy-activate.md so a failed commit or pre-deploy check now BLOCKS the deploy step and explicitly forbids giving the operator a manual Worker deploy command. The companion 6435 fragment was updated in the same run to match; 6469 was not.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md line 6, the "What this means for operators" sentence "if commit protection cannot be verified, the command will guide you through the step rather than deploying itself".
  Evidence of absence: LAST RUN DIFF replaced the live and template Cloudflare Steps "No credential → fall back to guide-and-paste" wording with "No credential → pause Cloudflare steps" that marks the step BLOCKED and never offers manual commands (deploy-activate.md live and template in LAST RUN DIFF), and tightened the "Deploy only a verified, immutable default-branch commit" bullet to say "Never emit a Worker deploy command, including one for the operator to run". CLAUDE.md §24.C was updated to "do not offer a manual Worker deploy as a workaround" and the README.md addition explicitly says "it is not a manual deployment fallback". changelog.d/6435-prompt-audit-claude-config.md's "What this means for consumer repos" was updated in the same run to say "Failed or unverified commit and pre-deploy checks block Worker deployment rather than handing out manual deploy commands". But changelog.d/6469-deploy-activate-credential-free-checks.md is not in LAST RUN CHANGED FILES, and its "What this means for operators" sentence still reads "if commit protection cannot be verified, the command will guide you through the step rather than deploying itself" — directly contradicting the now-shipped BLOCK behavior. The next @stable release will publish this fragment to consumer repos via scripts/assemble_changelog.py, so consumers will read a "guide you through" promise the command no longer keeps. CLAUDE.md §20 makes every behavior change shipped in the PR require a fragment, and the 6469 fragment is the dedicated place this tightening was supposed to land.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
